description: A finite disjunction is false under a valuation exactly when every formula in its list is false.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.eval_finiteDisj_false.{u} {α : Type u} (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Valuation α)
  (l : List (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.eval v (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.finiteDisj l) = false ↔
    ∀ A ∈ l, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.eval v A = false
